## Architecture

| --- | --- |
| principles | Hexagonal, functional core/imperative shell; typed evidence rather than inferred telemetry facts; shared SDK semantics; one app registry; immutable bounded query views; privacy-aware projections and actionable outcomes. Existing source contracts remain separate from new query reconstruction. Source-supported coverage is explicit across all registered representations. |
| composition_root | crates/app/src/main.rs and adapters.rs compose existing collection plus QueryService&lt;LocalQuerySource/registered Git-note bridge&gt;, injected QueryWriter and the thin CLI. Native parsing lives only in format adapters; source I/O only in concrete loaders; SDK never imports those concrete adapters. docs/schema/help/version require no source/config/Git construction. |
| contracts | C1 — dependency direction and source separation. Core owns query DTOs, schemas, typed errors/actions and object-safe QueryApi/QuerySource/QueryAdapter/QueryWriter ports under crates/core/src/query/. SDK owns QueryService and every identity/reconstruction/filter/context/statistics rule under crates/sdk/src/query/. New unisphere-loader-query is the imperative local-discovery/provider adapter, reusing loader-jsonl and loader-snapshot; new unisphere-output-query serializes only SDK-approved projections. Existing format crates implement QueryAdapter alongside their unchanged OTLP ports by sharing native decode/classification helpers; inspect before destructive Value::remove and do not parse emitted OTLP back into query facts. Query-only inspection must not allocate a discarded TelemetryRecord, and OTLP-only mapping must not construct a query graph. CLI depends normally only on core/clap/serde_json; app alone composes SDK, concrete source/format/output adapters and process context. Extend app::adapters::ADAPTERS in place; no second adapter-name/location registry. SDK pure entry execute_view(view:&QueryView, request:&QueryRequest)-&gt;Result&lt;QueryResponse,QueryFailure&gt; supports repeated queries without rereading sources. QuerySource is explicit I/O, not an ambient singleton; all fakes implement these same ports., C3 — inputs and source references. Dataset = Sources\|Sessions\|Turns\|Messages\|Tools\|Events; Operation = List\|Show{entity:EntityId}\|Tree{session:EntityId}\|Check{source:SourceId}\|Stats{group_by:Vec&lt;FieldId&gt;,metrics:Vec&lt;Metric&gt;}\|Extract. QueryScope = Repository{path:PathBuf,scope:RepoScope}\|Source{selector:SourceSelector}\|Offline{input:OfflineRef}; RepoScope=Exact\|Tree\|Worktrees; SourceSelector=Path{path:PathBuf,adapter:Option&lt;String&gt;}\|Id(SourceId); OfflineRef=File(PathBuf)\|Stdin. CLI/app resolves relative paths against injected cwd, not SDK ambient cwd. QueryInput = Native(NativeQueryView)\|Saved{bytes:Arc&lt;[u8]&gt;,format:SavedFormat}; NativeQueryView owns sources:Vec&lt;SourceEvidence&gt;, observations:Vec&lt;Observation&gt;, repository_roots:Vec&lt;PathBuf&gt;, coverage:Coverage. SourceEvidence fields: local source id, registered adapter/harness IDs, native representation, validated local locator, revision, read status, association observations and capability flags. NativeQueryInput borrows either source+NativeRecord slice, NativeSnapshot, or provided object bytes+GitNote locator; no filesystem handle enters a pure adapter. Raw observation/input types are not Serialize and must not derive content-bearing Debug., C4 — observation vocabulary. Observation fields: source_ref, native_record_id:Option&lt;String&gt;, session:Option&lt;SessionEvidenceKey&gt;, branch:BranchEvidence, parent_ids:Vec&lt;String&gt;, sequence:NativeSequence, timestamp:Option&lt;Timestamp&gt;, facets:Vec&lt;ObservationFacet&gt;, diagnostics:Vec&lt;AvailabilityIssue&gt;. SessionEvidenceKey preserves native namespace/id, optional participant/agent discriminator, parent/fork declarations and source-local membership basis; it never globalizes a bare native ID. NativeSequence is a versioned source-local order key (JSONL offset; document path/index; validated Cursor header position; Pi/OMP parent-tree node), not wall-clock causality. ObservationFacet=SessionMetadata{native_id,name,models,created_at,associations,lineage}\|Message{native_id,role,parts,request_marker,turn_id}\|ToolCall{native_call_id,native_name,family,input,turn_id}\|ToolResult{native_call_id,native_name,output,outcome,exit_code,reported_duration,turn_id}\|ToolProgress{native_call_id,parts}\|Control{kind,links}\|Usage{owner,scope,counters}\|Attribution{identity_kind,native_key,declared_agent,target_commit,ranges}. Each optional field has an explicit unavailable reason; request_marker=Initiating\|ToolResponse\|Injected\|Summary\|Unknown. Parts retain only supported text/reasoning/structured call/result payloads under ContentAccess; opaque signatures, encrypted provider state, attachments and unresolved sidecars stay unavailable. Tool families are a static registered mapping by adapter plus native name, not a text guess., C5 — identity and read-view freshness. EntityId and SourceId are validated q1:&lt;kind&gt;:&lt;64 lowercase hex&gt; wrappers. Hashes use SHA-256 over domain-tagged length-prefixed UTF-8 components, not ambiguous concatenation or Rust DefaultHasher. Source IDs include registered adapter/representation and canonical physical locator; revisions are separate. Event fallback identity uses source ID + native locator/subrecord, never display text. Snapshot index-based locations are revision-local: include revision when a format supplies no stable native key/ID. Preserve all supporting source references on reconciled rows. Merge copies only with compatible native session/participant/branch identity AND proven common origin or equal complete supported-source fingerprints; same native ID or equal user text alone never proves sameness. Conflicting reused IDs remain separate with explicit conflict coverage. Git-declared agent IDs do not merge with transcript sessions without a verified namespace/provenance relation. QueryView is immutable; its digest covers schema/reconstruction versions, sorted source IDs/revisions/coverage and selected repository associations. JSONL query loads read a complete bounded source view and fingerprint actual framed bytes including current tail evidence; retain the existing append cursor contract for OTLP unchanged. Detect mutation while loading; every fresh query re-observes its sources. Snapshot revisions retain existing loader semantics. No cross-store atomicity or durable history is claimed., C6 — repository discovery and provider composition. LocalQuerySource::new(registrations:Vec&lt;QueryRegistration&gt;, context:LocalQueryContext)-&gt;Self; QueryRegistration contains the existing AdapterDescriptor and an injected QueryAdapter plus its registered native representation. LocalQueryContext explicitly supplies available HOME/platform bases, optional absolute standard-Git executable and optional bounded stdin bytes; no SDK environment lookup. Enumerate only registered LocationHint patterns with bounded source/byte counts; reject symlink traversal outside supplied roots, special files and unsupported representations. Existing JSONL/snapshot readers remain the only file/value framing implementations; extend their query snapshot helpers rather than duplicating secure-open/read code. Native cwd/header evidence is available in Codex session_meta, OMP/Pi session headers and Copilot context records; Claude cwd requires an explicitly supported native field. VS Code workspace metadata and Cursor path encodings remain association hints until a tested native metadata join proves the path; do not silently claim repository membership for global/mixed stores. SDK applies component-safe exact/tree/worktree matching to evidence supplied by the provider, before content predicates or projection. Worktrees requires bounded standard-Git verification using the injected executable; unavailable Git is an actionable capability error only for that operation. Keep multiple/moving repository associations and their evidence; a source containing another repository does not authorize emitting that partition. Report absent/unreadable/unsupported/unassociated/conflicting categories separately; metadata-only sessions survive. Explicit --source remains the remedy for a known source whose repo association cannot be established. SDK derives SourceSelection from adapter/harness predicate groups before load; the provider validates and prunes registrations before globbing/opening/decoding their stores. Excluded registrations cannot fail the query or force allow-partial. Report excluded adapter IDs, not invented counts of unenumerated source files. Explicit source selectors conflicting with SourceSelection fail before reads., C7 — logical datasets and reconstruction. QueryView owns typed SourceRow, SessionRow, TurnRow, MessageRow, ToolRow and EventRow collections plus ID/order indices; all operations select these same rows. SourceRow retains source/revision/read/association facts; SessionRow has known native identity, name/model observations, source refs, started_at versus first_event_at, lineage and qualified observed counts; MessageRow has role, timestamp, supported parts and membership; TurnRow has initiating request, stable one-based ordinal in a selected session/branch view and message/call memberships; ToolRow has invocation identity, original name/family, inputs/results/progress refs, status/exit/time/duration basis; EventRow always preserves the underlying observation even when no higher-level row can be justified. Versioned reconstruction policies: Claude explicit user text initiates an episode along supported parent chains, tool-result-only user shapes do not; Codex explicit turn IDs/lifecycle evidence takes precedence and event summaries are not duplicate response_item messages; OMP/Pi use the session header and explicit parent tree, distinguish user/toolResult/custom/compaction/branch roles and never choose an active leaf by recency; Copilot uses explicit turn/tool IDs and parent links, keeping context changes source-qualified; VS Code uses request/response containment after its existing journal reducer; Cursor IDE uses validated composer/header ordering and only supported request boundaries; idless Cursor transcript fragments lacking demonstrated boundaries remain events/messages, with unavailable turns/call pairing. Header membership is a new explicitly versioned query rule, not a change to record-local OTLP mapping., C8 — branches, copies and context. Preserve observed parent/fork/subagent relationships; do not traverse parentSession paths or synthesize missing parents. Cycles, repeated conflicting node IDs and dangling links are surfaced. A logical initiating request shared by branch prefixes has one logical turn ID and branch-qualified membership edges; listing across branches does not invent duplicate consumption. Branch-specific message/call links must remain labeled, never flattened into a causal transcript. Only --range requires exactly one selected session and branch. Context expansion partitions matched rows by their admitted session/branch and supports multiple unambiguous groups in one repository query; multiple sessions alone are not ambiguous. Linear text/Markdown renders separate labeled session/branch sections, never concatenates branches as one timeline. An actually ambiguous branch selector or unresolved membership returns AmbiguousBranch with valid local branch IDs. --range a:b is inclusive, one-based and applied to full-view ordinals before other filters. Context before/after is only for turns/messages, applied after matching over native conversation order in the same session/branch; union overlapping windows, mark match/context, retain dates outside the filter window and report matched versus emitted. Exact show never picks an arbitrary ambiguous native ID. --unresolved reject\|separate governs otherwise-conflicting logical identity in stats: reject is default; separate retains explicit uncertainty and must not label totals exact. This is not --allow-partial, which only permits named source-read failures. Context cannot cross the already-admitted repository/source/participant scope even when an underlying session moved between repositories; time predicates may expand, authority boundaries may not., C9 — query request and selection. QueryRequest fields: dataset, operation, scope, filters:Vec&lt;Filter&gt;, time:TimeWindow, branch:Option&lt;EntityId&gt;, turn_range:Option&lt;InclusiveRange&gt;, sort:Vec&lt;SortKey&gt;, columns:Option&lt;Vec&lt;FieldId&gt;&gt;, limit:Option&lt;usize&gt;, cursor:Option&lt;String&gt;, context:ContextWindow, include_content:bool, allow_partial:bool, unresolved:UnresolvedPolicy, limits:QueryLimits. FieldId is a closed per-dataset enum-backed registry; FieldValue is typed Null/Bool/Integer/Float/String/Timestamp/Id/IdList/Structured. Filters use typed operations Equal/In/Exclude/Contains/Regex/Glob/AtLeast/Has, validated against DatasetSchema; no user expression language. Across fields AND, repeated values within one field OR, exclusions subtract last. Literal/regex/name-glob remain distinct and case-sensitive unless explicit ignore-case. Positive comparisons on unknown/null do not match; undeclared dataset fields/operations fail with valid alternatives. Offline absent projected fields required by the operation fail availability validation, whereas declared nulls remain unknown. List defaults to 50, extract to all, limit 0 all within safety bounds; stats reduces the full match set before output-group limits. Session model matching is any observed model; message/tool model is only row-attributed evidence. Query identity filtering uses CLI --source-adapter; --adapter is reserved to the explicitly native legacy forms in C20, never a second spelling for the query filter. SourceSelection applies eligible adapter/harness include/exclude groups before provider I/O. Saved-input completeness and repeated execute_view scope are governed by C23, not inferred from EOF or row count., C10 — time, ordering and continuation. Timestamp stores an exact parsed instant and its observed basis; wire timestamp is normalized RFC3339 UTC with supported fractional precision. since inclusive/until exclusive; YYYY-MM-DD is UTC midnight; invalid/locale/relative dates fail. Defaults: sessions/turns/tools started_at, messages/events timestamp, sources source ID. Session started_at is native creation only; first_event_at is separate; file mtime never means activity. With a time predicate, unknown timestamps are excluded unless include-undated; without one, retain them. Missing values sort last in either direction, stable entity-ID tie break; native branch/context order is independent of timestamp display order. Continuation is a bounded URL-safe token containing version, view digest, normalized request digest and next index, plus corruption checksum; no raw paths, names, patterns or payload sort keys. It is not an authorization token. Request digest includes selection, projection/content policy, sorting, branch/range/context and operation; changed source view or options refuse StaleCursor rather than silently restart. Reject invalid tokens, out-of-range indices and tokens over 2 KiB. No persistent cursor store or daemon., C11 — tool outcomes, duration and statistics. Pair only supported native IDs within session/participant/branch scope. Preserve independent retries, interleaving, duplicate/ambiguous terminals and unmatched results; no adjacency/text pairing. Outcome=Succeeded\|Failed\|Cancelled\|Incomplete\|Unknown; explicit terminal timeout is Failed with Timeout reason, not an invented duration. isComplete/confirmation alone does not prove success. Duration is finite nonnegative milliseconds, either source-reported for that invocation or compatible matched endpoint clocks, with DurationBasis=SourceReported\|PairedClock; missing/ambiguous/reversed/overflowing clocks produce unavailable duration and a reason, never zero. Source-reported and paired-clock values both count as measured, with separate basis counts and a filter/group field. Stats metrics are a closed typed set: count, measured_count, missing_duration_count, succeeded, failures, cancelled, incomplete, unknown, failure_rate, mean_ms, min_ms, max_ms, p50_ms, p95_ms and source-qualified token buckets. failure_rate denominator is succeeded+failed+cancelled known terminal outcomes; cancellation is neither success nor failure, timeout is failed, incomplete/unknown excluded, empty denominator null. Mean/percentiles use only finite measured values from the same matched ToolRows; exact nearest rank ceil(p*n), no approximation. JSON numbers use round-trip finite IEEE-754 ms values; human display may round to 3 decimals and labels it. Allocate/sort duration samples only for requested percentiles; retain named units/denominators/missingness. Cumulative snapshots and replayed/forked prefixes never become new usage: compatible native-owned cumulative groups use the latest observed snapshot with provenance, not a sum; incompatible/unresolved ownership has unavailable aggregate. No monetary estimate or productivity ranking., C12 — privacy, projection and serialization. ContentAccess is derived by the SDK from requested content predicates and output consent; a search authorizes inspection of its named payload only, not echoing it. Build typed rows once and project only selected fields, not clones of whole source payloads. DatasetSchema declares sensitivity and availability for every field. Titles/names, bodies/reasoning, commands/arguments/results, human identity and arbitrary native extension strings are sensitive; source paths/native identity fields receive explicit schema classification and sentinel proof, not assumptions based on a harness setting. Requested sensitive columns/parts and text/Markdown payload extraction without include-content return ContentConsentRequired; never silently empty a denied field. No raw input, content-bearing query values or source stderr in errors/actions/cursors/logs/temp reports. No sidecar/URL/attachment dereference. ProjectedRow is a validated field-ID-to-typed-value map; QueryResponse contains only approved projections plus safe coverage/query description and semantic next action, so SDK consumers and serializers cannot accidentally receive an unprojected raw graph through execute. Raw QueryView is an explicit in-process evidence API, not serializable output. JSONL has reserved schema_version/dataset/id/provenance plus declared fields at the row top level; summaries/actions stay off stdout. CSV RFC4180 UTF-8, null empty, compound JSON text, numeric cells numeric; default spreadsheet escaping prefixes dangerous strings, explicit raw warns and preserves consent. Human terminal controls and Markdown/HTML are escaped without changing raw JSON content. CSV is explicitly lossy: projected absence, null and empty string may collapse to the same cell; structured values are JSON text. Its schema format capability reports these losses and each CSV result's diagnostic guidance recommends JSON/JSONL when exact field availability matters. Typed SDK/JSON/JSONL availability is not claimed to round-trip through CSV., C13 — resource and output boundaries. QueryLimits defaults/hard ceilings: sources 4096/16384; total input bytes 256 MiB/1 GiB; source bytes 64 MiB/256 MiB; decoded observations+rows 200000/1000000; retained query/sort/aggregation payload accounting 256 MiB/1 GiB; output bytes 128 MiB/512 MiB; pattern bytes 4096/4096; patterns 64/64; total scanned text across predicates 256 MiB/1 GiB; context neighbours 1000/1000; branch memberships 1000000/4000000; cursor bytes 2048/2048. Retain existing JSONL 1 MiB record/4 MiB batch defaults and snapshot 32 MiB value/64 MiB source defaults, constrained further by aggregate query limits. Validate zero/overflow/impossible combinations before provider/output calls. Account expansion before growing retained collections, sort indices, grouped state or projected output; bound parser nesting and compiled regex size to 1 MiB per pattern; regex engine is Rust regex, glob syntax uses globset rather than a new language. These are logical payload/work bounds, not an exact OS RSS claim. Fail explicitly, never silently truncate or approximate. File output stages in a private temporary file in the selected parent and publishes create-new/no-clobber only after flush succeeds; remove owned temporary data on failure, never alter existing destination/source stores. Stdout can be partial on later failure: nonzero exit plus safe diagnostic, no successful final summary/checkpoint. Exercise broken pipes and failed diagnostic writes., C14 — actionable outcome contract. Core QueryResponse.next_action is a typed semantic action (InspectEntity, Continue, NarrowSelection, InspectCoverage, ReadSchema, ReadRecipe) with safe IDs/cursor, reason and explicit needed-input fields, not CLI-built shell text. QueryFailure has QueryFailureCode, safe structural location, retryable and RecoveryAction; fixed public explanations never format raw serde/I/O/clap errors. Codes cover InvalidArgument/Field/Pattern/Time, MissingSource, UnreadableSource, UnsupportedSource/Schema/Operation, InvalidData, AmbiguousIdentity/Branch, StaleCursor, MissingField, InputSubset, ViewScopeMismatch, ContentConsentRequired, ResourceLimit and OutputFailure. CLI maps actions/recovery through its actual parser schema into a nonempty next_action containing a readable step plus argv and any named required inputs; no action executes. Every success/empty/partial/help/version/export and every error is covered, including legacy config/catalog/list/OTLP paths. Invalid fields/options/topics name safe alternatives; stale cursor says start a fresh query; refused content says choose metadata or deliberately consent; bounds say narrow scope or explicitly configure within the ceiling; write failure says choose a new destination and do not trust partial bytes. Raw data formats keep actions on stderr summaries. A generic docs link/key-presence assertion is insufficient proof; parser-backed and representative executed next-step cases are required., C15 — source capability and Git-ai integration. Preserve all 9 current registrations and 10 demonstrated native representations (VS Code document+journal). Explicitly support metadata/observations where higher-level fields are unavailable: Cursor transcript has no native timestamps/IDs/results; VS Code journal is only its reduced current revision; Copilot legacy chat/timeline are separate views; Cursor IDE uses key-validated main-spine order and mixed-store coverage. ParsedCommand=Config\|Catalog\|Docs\|Schema\|Query(QueryCommand)\|NativeRootList\|NativeGitNotesList\|NativeExport\|Help\|Version. Native --adapter remains a dispatch selector (default claude-code only where existing native root-list/export already does so). Query identity/source-format filtering is renamed --source-adapter everywhere, with NO --adapter alias on query forms; --harness remains the family filter. Thus sessions list --repo . --harness claude-code and sessions list --repo . --source-adapter git-ai reach QueryApi; sessions list --adapter git-ai --repo . reaches native notes listing; sessions list --root PATH remains legacy. --repo is repository-association scope on query forms and the native Git repository on explicitly native git-ai list/export; --input is saved query input on query operations and native input on sessions export. Docs/schema/help/version parse and render before provider/config/Git acquisition. Remove requested_session_adapter and migrate every app/test caller; one ADAPTERS registry supplies native dispatch and query registrations. Regression proof covers all old forms with the same semantic data and stream placement (additive next-action metadata permitted), every new catalogue form and rejected mixed forms. OTLP bytes remain unchanged., C21 — complete cross-lane DTO freeze set (F2). InspectedSource {source:SourceEvidence, partitions:Vec&lt;SourcePartition&gt;, observations:Vec&lt;Observation&gt;, issues:Vec&lt;AvailabilityIssue&gt;}. SourcePartition {id:PartitionId, native_session_id:Option&lt;String&gt;, participant_id:Option&lt;String&gt;, view:SourceViewKind, membership:MembershipPolicy, associations:Vec&lt;AssociationObservation&gt;}; SourceViewKind=Conversation\|MainSpine\|LegacyChat\|LegacyTimeline\|SourceOnly; MembershipPolicy=ExplicitRecordIds\|ValidatedHeader\|NativeContainment\|Unavailable. PartitionId is a validated source-local identity wrapper, not a fabricated conversation ID. Coverage {discovered_sources:u64, loaded_sources:u64, selected_sources:u64, source_status:BTreeMap&lt;SourceReadStatus,u64&gt;, association_status:BTreeMap&lt;AssociationStatus,u64&gt;, excluded_adapters:Vec&lt;AdapterId&gt;, source_read_complete:bool, issues:Vec&lt;AvailabilityIssue&gt;, universe:ResultUniverse}. SourceReadStatus=Readable\|Absent\|Unreadable\|Unsupported\|Partial; AssociationStatus=Matched\|OutsideScope\|Unassociated\|Conflict. AvailabilityIssue {code:AvailabilityCode, field:Option&lt;FieldId&gt;, source:Option&lt;SourceId&gt;, entity:Option&lt;EntityId&gt;, offset:Option&lt;u64&gt;}; AvailabilityCode=Absent\|NotSupported\|NotCaptured\|Partial\|Ambiguous\|Conflict\|InvalidClock\|MissingCompletion\|SensitiveOmitted\|ProjectionMissing\|InputSubset\|Unassociated\|Stale. No arbitrary diagnostic detail string is allowed. BranchEvidence=Linear{partition:PartitionId}\|Node{partition:PartitionId,native_id:String,parent:Option&lt;String&gt;,declared_branch:Option&lt;String&gt;,links:Vec&lt;BranchLink&gt;}\|Unavailable{partition:PartitionId,reason:AvailabilityCode}; BranchLink {kind:LineageKind,target:String}; LineageKind=Parent\|Fork\|Subagent\|CompactionFrom\|FirstKept\|NativeLink. These are raw typed evidence, not serialized strings or authority to follow a path. SavedFormat=QueryJsonV1\|QueryJsonlV1. ContentAccess {inspect_fields:BTreeSet&lt;FieldId&gt;,emit_content:bool}; permits_payload(field) iff emit_content or inspect_fields contains field; mandatory structural IDs needed for identity/provenance are retained internally independently of optional payload retention and still content-gated at output. QueryOutputOptions {format:OutputFormat,csv_safety:CsvSafety,max_output_bytes:usize,next_action:RenderedAction}; OutputFormat=Json\|Jsonl\|Csv\|Table\|Text\|Markdown; CsvSafety=Spreadsheet\|Raw; Table is --human query presentation, while Text/Markdown extracts remain payload-sensitive. RenderedAction {summary:String,argv:Vec&lt;String&gt;,required_inputs:Vec&lt;String&gt;}; instruction-only recovery may have empty argv but nonempty cause-specific summary. RecoveryAction=ChooseField{dataset:Dataset,allowed:Vec&lt;FieldId&gt;}\|ChooseAdapter{allowed:Vec&lt;AdapterId&gt;}\|ChooseEntity{dataset:Dataset,candidates:Vec&lt;EntityId&gt;}\|ChooseBranch{candidates:Vec&lt;EntityId&gt;}\|FixSource{reason:SourceProblem,source:Option&lt;SourceId&gt;}\|StartFreshQuery\|SupplyFields{required:Vec&lt;FieldId&gt;}\|UseMetadataOrConsent{fields:Vec&lt;FieldId&gt;}\|NarrowQuery{limit:LimitKind}\|ChooseNewOutput{discard_partial:bool}\|UseCompleteInput\|ReopenView\|ConsultSchema{dataset:Dataset}; SourceProblem=Missing\|Permissions\|UnsupportedDialect\|InvalidData\|ChangedDuringRead\|GitUnavailable; LimitKind names each C13 bound. CLI topic/option errors derive safe alternatives from its parser/docs registry, not raw argv. All these exact Rust declarations, constructors/validation, their schema and fake implementations are in the wave0 freeze set; no wave1 dispatch until committed files/checks and an independent exact-baseline review are sealed in team/baseline.dd.json. A changed shared field/signature returns to tk-0001 and invalidates dependent proof. AssociationObservation {basis:AssociationBasis,path:Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,partition:PartitionId,applies_to:AssociationExtent}; AssociationBasis=NativeCwd\|NativeGitRoot\|VerifiedWorkspaceMetadata\|GitRepositoryIdentity\|StoreHint; AssociationExtent=Partition\|Record(NativeSequence)\|From{start:NativeSequence,until:Option&lt;NativeSequence&gt;}. StoreHint alone never admits rows. Context changes delimit native association intervals rather than relabeling a whole source; canonicalization is confined to explicitly admitted local roots, not arbitrary source-provided paths or remote URLs. FormatCapability {format:OutputFormat,lossy:bool,losses:Vec&lt;FormatLoss&gt;}; FormatLoss=AbsenceNullEmptyCollapse\|StructuredAsJsonText\|HumanRounding\|PresentationOnly. SourceReadStatus/AssociationStatus/AvailabilityCode/FieldId/AdapterId/HarnessId derive ordering needed by their sets/maps; IDs and counts use validated constructors and bounded collections, not lane-specific aliases., C22 — pre-I/O source selection (F3). SourceSelection {include_adapters:BTreeSet&lt;AdapterId&gt;,exclude_adapters:BTreeSet&lt;AdapterId&gt;,include_harnesses:BTreeSet&lt;HarnessId&gt;,exclude_harnesses:BTreeSet&lt;HarnessId&gt;}; empty includes mean all allowed registered identities, values within a group OR, adapter and harness groups AND, exclusions subtract. QueryService extracts only these source-level predicates before QuerySource::load; row/model/name/time/content filters stay in the SDK. SourceSelection is part of the view/request binding. A provider must not enumerate or read excluded registrations, so their permission errors, malformed input and size cannot affect strict selected-source success. Unknown live adapter/harness identifiers return typed valid-alternative guidance before source reads. Offline filters operate on the explicitly supplied saved rows with no live registry/store lookup. Explicit path/ID and selection contradictions fail before I/O. Field/capability availability remains source-qualified after loading; allow_partial never becomes a workaround for excluded-store failures., C23 — saved-universe completeness and in-process scope binding (F5). ResultUniverse {source_view_digest:Option&lt;Digest&gt;,selection_digest:Digest,columns_digest:Digest,columns:Vec&lt;FieldId&gt;,applied_limit:Option&lt;usize&gt;,rows_complete_for_selection:Completeness,partitions_complete:Completeness,basis:UniverseBasis,bounded_by_input:bool}; Completeness=Complete\|Subset\|Unknown; UniverseBasis=LiveView\|SavedSelection\|ProvidedRows. JSON envelopes carry universe alongside coverage; serializers preserve it. Complete selected matches do NOT imply a complete source/session/branch universe: partitions_complete is Complete only when every needed row/order/membership field for each admitted partition is included, without unresolved gaps. A non-null next_cursor or emitted&lt;matched prevents claiming all matched rows are present; context rows may make emitted&gt;matched and do not prove completeness either. Validate metadata consistency and required projected fields; duplicate/conflicting row IDs or malformed envelopes fail. Standalone JSONL cannot prove capture completeness through EOF, so without an explicitly supplied, validated completeness record it is ProvidedRows/Unknown and bounded_by_input=true; do not add a fake summary row or implicitly open sidecars. Filtering/list/show can operate on provided rows. Statistics over saved subsets remain exact only for provided rows and explicitly bounded_by_input, never totals for the original selection/source; missing metric fields still fail. Offline context or higher-level reconstruction refuses with InputSubset/UseCompleteInput unless required partitions/order/relationship fields are complete—never silently shorten neighbours. The recovery is a complete versioned JSON extraction, not live enrichment. QueryView records its admitted scope, SourceSelection, fields and universe; execute_view may narrow that view but must refuse widening scope or unavailable fields with an explicit reopen/supply-input action, never return a misleading empty answer. These are validated supplied provenance claims, not authentication of a third-party file., C24 — explicit lane and SDK milestones (F6). Parser lanes own native fact classification, source references, supported field availability and versioned membership evidence; they do not own cross-source identity, logical turn construction, pairing, context or aggregates. Their per-dialect done conditions in units are distinct. Keep tk-0008 one owner but require five ordered internal milestones: M1 admitted-scope SourceSelection, typed input/schema validation and source/session identity/lineage; M2 message/event/turn/call graph with source-qualified memberships and ambiguity; M3 typed filters/time/order/view-bound continuations; M4 recursive privacy projection, multi-partition context and saved-universe availability; M5 matched-row statistics, duration/usage denominators, semantic actions and errors. Each milestone adds meaningful groups to the same SDK query test target and an observed proof checkpoint at PM validation; no milestone is a fake completed unit, stub API release or arbitrary test quota. The final imported SDK delivery implements all five; source-format floors remain visible throughout. |

<a id="fan-out"></a>

## Fan out

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| decision | coders |
| rationale | Ten bounded coder responsibilities are genuinely independent against core query ports, typed observations, projection schemas and public fakes: five parser-family lanes, local discovery, SDK query semantics, reusable output, offline docs and CLI integration. Keep the tightly coupled SDK identity/reconstruction/filter/context/statistics engine under one owner instead of splitting noun handlers that would disagree. Nine lanes can start after the PM contract baseline; CLI follows docs/output, and the PM composes all concrete pieces. Candidate count is not a quota; no same-wave sibling implementation imports. |

| risk-source-evidence | Several native representations lack repository association, timestamps, call IDs or turn boundaries; expanding query capability must not fabricate them or quietly drop a registered dialect. | Per-representation query fixtures and capability matrix, sources/events availability, and external/installed composition cases. |
| risk-shared-semantics | The SDK engine is deliberately one larger unit because identity/reconstruction/filter/context/stats share a logical graph; splitting it by CLI nouns would create contradictory datasets. | One accountable SDK owner plus exact ports/fakes; peer decomposition review must assess its size and independence without a worker-count quota. |
| risk-privacy-actions | Default metadata, raw source strings, offline projections and generated next actions can leak content through channels not exercised by happy-path tables. | Field sensitivity baseline; recursive projection; sentinel cases across outputs/errors/actions/cursors and invalid-argument recovery; installed hostile environment proof. |
| risk-snapshot-cursor | Mutable snapshots, equal-size JSONL rewrites, copied sources and branches can invalidate cursors or inflate counts. | Full supported-source fingerprints, versioned identity/reconstruction rules, stale-token refusal and exact copy/branch fixtures; no durable history claim. |
| risk-git-convergence | Plan014 candidate is committed, runtime-proven, independently approved and Main-accepted, but not yet landed/pushed; actual shared app/CLI/SDK history convergence remains Main-owned. | Pin actual owner checkpoint and coordinate reviewed convergence before bridge integration; generic query units have no dependency on its implementation. |
| risk-proof-ceiling | Current ready:true proves existing native projections only. New proof commands are BUILD/EXTEND plans until implemented and run; proposed recipes are not execution evidence. | Keep ACs unchecked and backpressure certainty Confident/Partial until exact-source query/docs receipts exist; never pre-check future work. |
| risk-tool-version | Installed Builder 0.14.0 uses map-first/no acknowledgement gate while bundled skill examples contain stale ack instructions; role availability is catalog evidence, not provider attestation. | Use live help/settings/ready/dispatch/review grammar and actual runtime bindings; no hidden isolation/model fallback. |
